rs3745274.sentence: Genotypes GT + TT of rs3745274 (CYP2B6 516G>T) are associated with increased risk of overall discontinuation of efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection at 96 weeks as compared to genotype GG.
rs3745274.explanation: In the ENCORE1 randomized trial of treatment‑naïve, HIV‑infected adults, Cox regression (adjusted for confounders) showed higher discontinuation risk among CYP2B6 516G>T carriers, consistent with higher efavirenz concentrations driving cessation; no p-value was reported here.

rs35599367.sentence: Genotypes CT + TT of rs35599367 (CYP3A4*22) are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection as compared to genotype CC.
rs35599367.explanation: ENCORE1 reported that none of the tested SNPs, including CYP3A4*22 (rs35599367), significantly predicted virological control at 96 weeks.

rs28399499.sentence: Genotypes TC + CC of rs28399499 (CYP2B6 983T>C) are associated with decreased risk of central nervous system adverse events when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection at 96 weeks as compared to genotype TT.
rs28399499.explanation: The study observed a lower risk of CNS adverse events in CYP2B6 983T>C carriers at 96 weeks, consistent with reduced CYP2B6 metabolism (less 8‑hydroxy‑efavirenz); effect noted in ENCORE1 without a reported p-value.

CYP2A6*17.sentence: CYP2A6*17 (rs28399454) carriers are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment‑naïve people with HIV infection as compared to non‑carriers.
CYP2A6*17.explanation: Although CYP2A6*17 was genotyped, ENCORE1 found no significant associations between any SNP and virological control at 96 weeks.

rs3003596.sentence: Genotypes TC + CC of rs3003596 (NR1I3 1089T>C) are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection as compared to genotype TT.
rs3003596.explanation: ENCORE1 reported no significant relationship between NR1I3 variants and 96‑week virological suppression.

rs4803419.sentence: Genotypes CT + TT of rs4803419 (CYP2B6 15582C>T) are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection as compared to genotype CC.
rs4803419.explanation: Despite pharmacokinetic differences by composite CYP2B6 genotype, ENCORE1 did not find SNPs (including CYP2B6 15582C>T) to predict virological failure at 96 weeks; notably, only 1/47 EFV400 patients with the low‑concentration wild‑type composite had pVL ≥200.

rs1045642.sentence: Genotype TT of rs1045642 (ABCB1 3435C>T) is associated with increased risk of central nervous system adverse events by approximately 131% when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection at 96 weeks as compared to genotype CC.
rs1045642.explanation: ENCORE1 post hoc analyses showed markedly higher CNS adverse event risk for ABCB1 3435TT versus CC at 96 weeks, aligning with prior findings linking this variant to toxicity-related EFV regimen failure.

rs8192726.sentence: Genotypes CA + AA of rs8192726 (CYP2A6*9B) are associated with increased risk of overall discontinuation of efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection at 96 weeks as compared to genotype CC.
rs8192726.explanation: In multivariable Cox regression at 96 weeks, CYP2A6*9B variant carriers had higher discontinuation risk, consistent with polymorphism-related EFV concentration differences influencing cessation.

rs2472677.sentence: Genotype TT of rs2472677 (NR1I2 63396C>T) is associated with decreased risk of overall discontinuation of efavirenz by about 22% in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection at 96 weeks as compared to genotype CC.
rs2472677.explanation: ENCORE1 found NR1I2 63396TT lowered discontinuation risk, plausibly via altered PXR/CYP3A4 activity and reduced EFV exposure; effect estimated at 22% reduction, though no p-value was provided.

rs2307424.sentence: Genotypes CT + TT of rs2307424 (NR1I3 540C>T) are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection as compared to genotype CC.
rs2307424.explanation: The trial reported no significant associations between NR1I3 variants and 96‑week virological suppression.

rs6785049.sentence: Genotypes AG + GG of rs6785049 (NR1I2 7635A>G) are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection as compared to genotype AA.
rs6785049.explanation: ENCORE1 indicated no significant relationship between this NR1I2 variant and virological control at 96 weeks.

rs28399454.sentence: Genotypes CT + TT of rs28399454 (CYP2A6*17) are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment-naïve people with HIV infection as compared to genotype CC.
rs28399454.explanation: Although genotyped, CYP2A6*17 showed no significant association with virological suppression at 96 weeks in ENCORE1.

CYP3A4*22.sentence: CYP3A4*22 (rs35599367) carriers are not associated with likelihood of achieving plasma HIV RNA <200 copies/mL at 96 weeks when treated with efavirenz in treatment‑naïve people with HIV infection as compared to CYP3A4*1/*1.
CYP3A4*22.explanation: Consistent with the overall finding that no SNP predicted 96‑week virological control, CYP3A4*22 showed no significant effect in ENCORE1.
